user.title: Add Evohome
user.description: Sign in with your Honeywell Evohome account.

yaml_deprecated.title: Evohome YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description:
Configuring Evohome using YAML is being removed.

Your existing YAML configuration has been imported into the UI automatically and can be safely removed from your configuration.yaml file.

confirm.title: Confirm removal of YAML configuration
confirm.description:
Please remove the `evohome:` section from your `configuration.yaml` file.

After removing the YAML configuration, submit this fix to dismiss the repair.

yaml_import_failed.title: YAML import failed
yaml_import_failed.description: Configuring Evohome using YAML is deprecated and the import failed. Please remove the `evohome` entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and set up the integration manually.

yaml_import_invalid_scan_interval.title: YAML import failed - Invalid scan interval
yaml_import_invalid_scan_interval.description:
Configuring Evohome using YAML is deprecated and the import failed due to an invalid scan_interval value.

The scan_interval must be at least 60 seconds. Please update the scan_interval value in your `evohome:` configuration to be at least 60 (or remove it to use the default), then restart Home Assistant. Alternatively, remove the entire `evohome:` section from your `configuration.yaml` file and set up the integration manually via the UI.

yaml_import_invalid_location_idx.title: YAML import failed - Invalid location index
yaml_import_invalid_location_idx.description:
Configuring Evohome using YAML is deprecated and the import failed due to an invalid location_idx value.

The location_idx value is outside the valid range for your account. Please check the valid range in the error logs and update the location_idx value in your `evohome:` configuration (or remove it to use the default of 0), then restart Home Assistant. Alternatively, remove the entire `evohome:` section from your `configuration.yaml` file and set up the integration manually via the UI.

clear_zone_override.description: Sets a zone to follow its schedule.
clear_zone_override.name: Clear zone override

refresh_system.description: Pulls the latest data from the vendor's servers now, rather than waiting for the next scheduled update.
refresh_system.name: Refresh system

reset_system.description: Sets the system to Auto mode and resets all the zones to follow their schedules. Not all Evohome systems support this feature (i.e. AutoWithReset mode).
reset_system.name: Reset system

set_system_mode.description: Sets the system mode, either indefinitely, or for a specified period of time, after which it will revert to Auto. Not all systems support all modes.

duration.description: The duration in hours; used only with AutoWithEco mode (up to 24 hours).
duration.name: Duration

mode.description: Mode to set the system to.
mode.name: [%key:common::config_flow::data::mode%]

period.description: A period of time in days; used only with Away, DayOff, or Custom mode. The system will revert to Auto mode at midnight (up to 99 days, today is day 1).
period.name: Period

set_system_mode.name: Set system mode

set_zone_override.description: Overrides a zone's setpoint, either indefinitely, or for a specified period of time, after which it will revert to following its schedule.

duration.description: The zone will revert to its schedule after this time. If 0 the change is until the next scheduled setpoint.
duration.name: Duration

entity_id.description: The entity ID of the Evohome zone.
entity_id.name: Entity

setpoint.description: The temperature to be used instead of the scheduled setpoint.
setpoint.name: Setpoint

set_zone_override.name: Set zone override
